title: Audit non-CloudWatch AWS static-key integrations
description: Follow-up from keyless CloudWatch work. Audit and refactor non-CloudWatch AWS integrations that still support or require static AWS access keys, including SQS/Celery dispatch and object-store helpers. Keep CloudWatch logging changes scoped and release independently.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Preparing a scoped fix so explicit AWS_PROFILE/AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE selection is not overridden by static AWS keys loaded from Plexus config. Validation target: ConfigLoader unit coverage for preserving profile-based credentials.
